subject: general
question: Ruler of Ballabhgarh, Sher Nahar Singh joined hands with which of the following Mughal emperor to defeat British?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bahadur Shah Jafar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Bahadur Shah Jafar**

 
 
• Bahadur Shah Zafar was born in **1775** at Delhi.
 
• When Zafar came to the throne in 1837, his rule extended only to Delhi and its surroundings.
 
• He was the last ruler of the Mughal Dynasty, which ruled India for about 300 years.
 
• His father was Akbar Shah and his mother was Lalbai. 
 
• During Bahadur Shah Zafar’s reign, Urdu poetry developed and reached its acme.
 
• The first war of Independence in India started in 1857 under the leadership of Bahadur Shah Zafar.
 
 
 
• **Sher Nahar Singh **
 
 
• Raja Nahar Singh was born in 1823 in Ballabhgarh, Haryana.
 
• Raja Nahar Singh was a hero of India's First War of Independence in 1857 and on 9th January 1858 he was hanged by the British.
 
• This day is celebrated in Haryana as Balidan Diwas (The Day of Sacrifice).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Akbar Shah**

 
 
• Akbar II granted the title of 'Raja' to the famous social and cultural reformer Ram Mohan Roy.
 
• He is credited with starting the Hindu-Muslim unity festival Phool Walon Ki Sair.
 
• East India Company.
 
 
 
• **Shah Alam**
 
 
• During his reign, the **Third Battle of Panipat** took place.
 
• Popularly known as** 'Ali Gauhar' **who was defeated in the Battle of Buxar in 1764 AD.
 
• Till 1772, he gave all his** Diwani Rights** of Bihar, Bengal and Orissa.
 
• **First Mughal ruler** who became East India Company Pensioner.
 
 
 
• **Shah Jahan**
 
 
• Shah Jahan was the fifth Mughal emperor of India who was the son of Jahangir.
 
• His grandfather Akbar gave him the name Khurram.
 
• He was given the title of "The Builder of the Marvels" as he had a remarkable ability to design new structures and redesign old forts.
 
• He built the Taj Mahal in Agra, the Moti Masjid in Lahore, Jama Masjid of Delhi, and Section of Agra Fort, etc
